name: H2O
tagline: 571K RGB-D frames (4 static + 1 ego Kinect) of 4 subjects handling 8 objects: both-hand 3D pose, 6-DoF object pose, 36 action classes.

annotations.format: TXT per frame (hand_pose, hand_pose_MANO, obj_pose, obj_pose_RT, cam_pose, action / verb labels) + PNG RGB-D
annotations.coverageNote: Per-frame hand (21 joints + MANO), 6-DoF object and camera poses for all 5 views; annotated flag per hand (0/1); action labels on the ego view (cam4) only.

action_labels.note: 36 action classes (11 verbs x 8 objects) + verb labels per frame, ego view

hand_pose.note: 21 3D joints per hand + MANO (3 trans, 48 pose, 10 shape) with annotated flag

object_pose.note: 6-DoF RT + 21 keypoints (center, 8 corners, 12 edge mids) + object meshes

camera_pose.note: 4x4 cam-to-world per frame per camera + intrinsics (fx, fy, cx, cy)

scene_3d.note: Scene point clouds from calibrated RGB-D (per paper)

annotations.sample:
# <subject>/<scene>/<seq>/cam4/hand_pose/000123.txt   (128 numbers)
1  x1 y1 z1 ... x21 y21 z21     # left : annotated flag + 21 joints (camera frame)
1  x1 y1 z1 ... x21 y21 z21     # right
# cam4/hand_pose_MANO/000123.txt (118 numbers): flag + 3 trans + 48 pose + 10 shape, per hand
# cam4/obj_pose/000123.txt (64 numbers)
5  x1 y1 z1 ... x21 y21 z21     # class 5 = milk; center, 8 corners, 12 edge midpoints
# cam4/obj_pose_RT/000123.txt : class + 4x4 cam-to-object
# cam4/cam_pose/000123.txt    : 16 numbers, 4x4 cam-to-world
# cam4/action_label/000123.txt: 23 (pour milk)     verb_label: 5 (pour)
